reason: Two of our bigger customers cut orders, so I have a hole to fill this year and referrals and fairs are not filling it fast enough. Nothing up front, three free meetings and the right to void bad ones means I lose little by trying the free list and then the pilot, but I go in expecting to take the playbook and run it myself afterwards.
objection: EUR 350 a meeting feels steep next to what I already pay for Apollo and Lemlist plus a junior person. I've seen agencies count a polite 15-minute call as a 'meeting'. And my team truly has no time, so I don't believe the '3 hours in total' until I see it.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies are names I already know or could pull from Apollo in an afternoon, I walk away and do it myself.
